mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.points > 0 AND l.create_time < #{before} THEN l.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earned_before, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.points < 0 THEN -l.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spent FROM pos_member m LEFT JOIN pos_points_log l ON l.member_id = m.id WHERE m.points > 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.points
